The error lies in the WebSurfer's output (or rather, the inability of the system to process the correct output) to derive the logical conclusion that the playing years do not overlap with the league's existence. Let's look at the instruction: "Extract and report the team name...". The WebSurfer reported the team name (Distillery) but failed to report the *time* clearly in a synthesized way (it was in the snippet text). The Planner then claimed the years weren't confirmed. This is a failure of the Planner to analyze. But if I must choose the agent that *made* the mistake leading to the wrong solution (the inability to solve), it is the Planner who failed to utilize the data.
